g.text: Spreader comparison: riser attachments, not overall shroud-support width
microAGU: slot-centered straps ~130–132 mm apart | HobbyKing: estimated ~175–200 mm
Curved outer extensions support the shroud.
They do not define the load-bearing riser spacing.
Treat as an estimate, not a dimensioned drawing.
Your riser spacing is roughly 30% narrower than stock; your straps ride the bolts at the slot centers.
The simulator uses 148.6 mm: about 13–14% too wide compared with the actual strap centers.
Sources: saved microAGU assembly transforms; SpreaderBarSpar.STEP; HobbyKing manual printed pp. 3 and 14.
Slot openings span Y = 60–72 mm and −72 to −60 mm; centers ±66 mm. User confirms straps near ±65 mm.
